# Known Iceberg-on-Gluten unit test failures -- Spark 3.5 / Scala 2.12.
#
# Baseline of Apache Iceberg's own `spark` + `spark-extensions` test classes
# EXPECTED to fail under Gluten/Velox. The Iceberg Spark UT (Gluten) workflow
# enforces this list: a failing test NOT listed here is a regression (fails CI);
# a listed test that now passes should be removed. Format:
# <fully.qualified.TestClass>#<test name>. Lines starting with '#' are comments.
# See README.md in this directory.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# NOT YET BOOTSTRAPPED. While this file has no entries the gate runs in `seed`
# mode instead of enforcing, so the first runs are never spuriously red. Seed it
# from a real run before relying on the signal:
#
#   1. Run the workflow via workflow_dispatch with update_baseline=true (pick a
#      single spark_versions value to seed one target at a time).
#   2. Download the `iceberg-spark-ut-known-failures-3.5` artifact from the
#      iceberg-spark-aggregate job and commit it over this file.
#
# IMPORTANT: regenerate the baseline under the SAME shard x fork configuration
# the gate runs with (see ICEBERG_NUM_SHARDS / ICEBERG_FORK_COUNT in
# iceberg_spark_ut.yml) -- failures that depend on memory pressure differ
# between configurations and would otherwise be flagged as regressions.
